name: @mycadet/linux
description: Electron wrapper for the Cadet Assistant Linux app.

scripts.dev:standalone: bun run install:all && bun run scripts/reclaim-dev-port.ts && concurrently --kill-others --names web,electron --prefix-colors blue,green "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron-only: bun install && bun run setup && bun run prepare:electron-dev && electron-vite dev
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on --timeout 180000 http://localhost:5173 && bun run prepare:electron-dev && electron-vite dev
scripts.build:web: cd ../web && bun install && bun run openapi-ts && bun run build && cd ../linux && mkdir -p resources && rm -rf resources/web-dist && cp -R ../web/dist resources/web-dist
scripts.build:app: cd ../app && bun install && bun run build && cd ../linux && mkdir -p resources && rm -rf resources/app-dist && cp -R ../app/dist/standalone resources/app-dist
